categories.main_business_segments: Cousins Properties operates primarily in the office real estate segment, focusing on the ownership, development, acquisition, leasing, and management of Class A office properties. The company also engages in opportunistic mixed-use developments, with a small portion of its portfolio including non-office assets such as retail and apartments. Operations are reviewed and managed by geographic area, with key markets in the Sun Belt region of the United States.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Cousins emphasizes sustainable building design and operations, incorporating industry standards such as LEED, EnergyStar, BOMA 360, and FitWel into its development and property management processes. The company utilizes a disciplined capital allocation approach, including selective development, opportunistic acquisitions, and timely dispositions, supported by strong local operating platforms in each major market. Energy efficiency, environmental resilience, and tenant-focused amenities are prioritized in both new developments and existing property upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are corporate tenants seeking high-quality office space, with a significant concentration in technology, financial services, professional services, legal, and energy sectors. Major tenants include Amazon, NCR, Meta Platforms, Pioneer Natural Resources, and Expedia. The company serves a diversified tenant base across industries, with the top 20 tenants accounting for 37.9% of annualized rent and no single tenant exceeding 7.3%.
categories.geographic_coverage: Cousins' operations are concentrated in the Sun Belt markets of the United States, specifically Atlanta, Austin, Tampa, Phoenix, Charlotte, Dallas, and Nashville. The majority of net operating income is derived from Atlanta (36.4%) and Austin (31.1%), with additional significant presence in Tampa, Phoenix, and Charlotte. The company maintains regional offices in each of these key markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cousins operates as an owner, developer, and manager of commercial real estate, positioning itself downstream in the real estate supply chain. The company provides finished office space and related services directly to end-user tenants, while also engaging in property development and redevelopment activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on maintaining a premier portfolio of newer, efficient, and resilient office properties in high-growth Sun Belt markets, supported by a low-leverage balance sheet. The company prioritizes sustainability, resilience, and operational excellence, with ongoing R&D in building efficiency, environmental impact reduction, and tenant wellness. Recent initiatives include setting measurable ESG goals, such as reducing energy, greenhouse gas emissions, and water usage by 25% over a 2018 baseline, and maintaining high rates of LEED and EnergyStar certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Cousins generates revenue primarily through rental income from operating leases with office tenants, including base rent, tenant reimbursements for operating expenses, and percentage rents. Additional revenue streams include development, management, and leasing fees from joint ventures and third parties, as well as gains from property sales and joint venture transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cousins competes with other office REITs, real estate owners, developers, financial institutions, pension funds, and private investors in its target markets. The company differentiates itself through its focus on premier, well-located, and resilient office assets in the Sun Belt, operational efficiency, and a strong reputation for quality and service. It is positioned as a leading Sun Belt office REIT with a trophy portfolio and a conservative balance sheet.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, Cousins owned or had interests in 19.1 million square feet of office space, with total assets of $7.5 billion and annual rental property revenues of $753.5 million. Funds from Operations (FFO) for 2022 were $408.8 million. The company maintains low leverage and a flexible balance sheet, with recent growth driven by selective acquisitions, developments, and strategic dispositions. Same property net operating income was stable year-over-year, with modest growth in non-same property NOI.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cousins offers tenants high-quality, sustainable, and resilient office environments in dynamic Sun Belt markets, emphasizing operational excellence, energy efficiency, and premier locations with access to transit and amenities. The company’s disciplined capital allocation, strong local market expertise, and commitment to ESG leadership provide competitive differentiation, attracting top-tier tenants and supporting long-term value creation for shareholders.
